svg.title: Leandro Araújo — Senior Software Engineer
svg.desc: AI agents and backend systems, with a product mindset. Building software since 2011. Stateful agents, tool integration, observability and human review. TypeScript, Node.js, React Native, AWS, GCP, Azure and Python for OCR. First employee at meutudo; built its Android and iOS app. Also worked on mobile products for Boticário and Sabesp, and remotely for a US healthtech. Brazil, UTC-3.

g.text: From interfaces to the systems behind them.
